tier_a.title: GURU: Revisiting RL for LLM Reasoning from A Cross-Domain Perspective
tier_a.hook: 92K-example corpus across 6 domains reveals that RL reasoning transfer depends on pretraining exposure. GURU-7B/32B SOTA among open RL-trained models (+7.9%/+6.7%).

tier_b.title: E2H Reasoner: Curriculum RL from Easy to Hard Tasks
tier_b.hook: Easy-to-hard curriculum makes RL viable for 1.5B-3B models via approximate policy iteration with convergence guarantees.

tier_b.title: Biosignal Fingerprinting: A Cross-Modal PPG-ECG Foundation Model
tier_b.hook: Multi-modal Masked Autoencoder on 3.4M paired ECG/PPG segments. AUROC 0.974 for 5-class CVD. Works with PPG alone at inference.

tier_b.title: PETSA: Parameter-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Time Series Forecasting
tier_b.hook: Low-rank adapters + dynamic gating for test-time adaptation of TS foundation models. Three-part loss (robust + frequency + patch-structural).

tier_c.title: MHGPO: Heterogeneous Group RL for Multi-Agent LLM Systems
tier_c.hook: Extends GRPO to multi-agent settings with heterogeneous reward structures.

tier_c.title: RAFT: Data Refinement and Adaptive Distillation for Domain Fine-Tuning
tier_c.hook: Iterative data refinement with adaptive temperature distillation for domain-specific fine-tuning.

tier_c.title: Test-Time Distillation for Continual Model Adaptation (CoDiRe)
tier_c.hook: Combines test-time training with knowledge distillation for continual domain shift.

tier_c.title: Compress-Distill: Reasoning Trace Compression for Knowledge Distillation
tier_c.hook: Compresses verbose chain-of-thought traces before distillation, reducing transfer cost.

tier_c.title: Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising for Multi-view 3D Reconstruction
tier_c.hook: Denoises latent representations using geometric priors for multi-view consistency.

tier_c.title: DiffThinker: Generative Multimodal Reasoning with Diffusion Models
tier_c.hook: Uses diffusion models as a reasoning backbone rather than autoregressive generation.

news.title: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8
news.summary: Dynamic workflows, Super-Agent benchmark leader. $5/$25 per 1M input/output tokens.

news.title: Google released Gemini 3.5 Flash at I/O 2026
news.summary: Outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on agentic benchmarks at 40% less cost. Agent-first design.

news.title: Microsoft released MAI-Code-1-Flash at Build 2026
news.summary: 5B-param coding model, first Microsoft in-house model without OpenAI involvement.

already_ported.description: Masked autoencoders from CV applied to paired PPG/ECG biosignals.
Test-time training concepts applied to time-series forecasting with parameter efficiency.

unported.technique: Cross-domain RL transfer analysis for reasoning
unported.hypothesis: Time-series is likely an underrepresented pretraining domain, meaning RL-based reasoning agents for sensor data will need dedicated in-domain RL corpora rather than relying on cross-domain transfer from math/code.

unported.technique: Easy-to-hard curriculum RL for small models
unported.hypothesis: Curriculum RL could enable small models suitable for wearable deployment to learn reasoning over physiological signals, where vanilla RL fails due to sparse rewards.
